content.text: You’ve built a digital product—an ebook, course, or template—and you’re ready to sell. But in Kenya, Stripe and PayPal are unavailable. Conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-my-unfiltered-take-3|COREMERCH guide to payment]] gateways reject you. This isn’t a temporary problem. It’s structural. Global payment networks exclude entire regions, leaving creators like you with no way to collect revenue. The solution isn’t a workaround. It’s sovereign commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-payment-gateways-cameroon-digital-products|The Full]]. This post explains how no-KYC payment gateways work, why they matter, and how to deploy them today. No platforms. No subscriptions. Full ownership. Built for creators who chose better [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-13|architecture]].

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-what-actually-how-9. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

No-KYC payment gateways are decentralized systems that process transactions without requiring identity verification. Unlike Stripe or PayPal, which demand personal and business documentation, these gateways operate on blockchain networks. They verify payments on-chain, not through centralized authorities. This matters because it removes geographic and institutional barriers. Creators in Kenya, Nigeria, or Zimbabwe can accept payments without relying on foreign platforms. The system is permissionless: no one can shut it down or freeze funds. It’s not a hack—it’s base-layer infrastructure. You own the entire stack after deployment. No platform fees. No revenue sharing. Just direct, peer-to-peer transactions. This isn’t about avoiding regulation. It’s about building systems that don’t require intermediaries to function. The result? Financial sovereignty for digital creators in regions where traditional systems fail.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture combines free and paid tools into a single, cohesive stack. Hosting uses GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which execute code without servers. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, depending on your stack. File delivery is managed via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2, ensuring instant access after payment. Payments are processed through NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and charges a flat 0.5% fee. The system uses webhooks to verify transactions on-chain. Once payment confirms, the backend automatically delivers the product. No manual intervention required. The entire process is automated, secure, and ownerless after deployment. You’re not renting infrastructure—you’re owning it.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, and software in regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other platforms are unavailable or severely restricted. If you’re in Kenya, Nigeria, Pakistan, or Zimbabwe, this is for you. If you’ve been rejected by payment gateways or forced to use unstable local systems, this is your solution. It’s also for creators who value infrastructure sovereignty. You don’t want to depend on platforms that can change terms, freeze accounts, or shut down overnight. This system gives you full control. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. Lifetime access. It’s pressure-tested against actual payment rejection, currency collapse, and financial isolation. Built in Zimbabwe, it’s designed for creators who need systems that work when everything else fails.
No-KYC payment gateways remove geographic and institutional barriers for digital creators.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack consists of five core components. First, hosting: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for static sites. Second, backend logic: Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for automation. Third, order storage: Supabase or Google Sheets for tracking transactions. Fourth, file delivery: Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for instant product access. Fifth, payments: NOWPayments for crypto processing. These components integrate seamlessly. For example, when a buyer sends payment, NOWPayments verifies the transaction on-chain and triggers a webhook. The backend (Cloudflare Workers or Apps Script) receives the webhook, updates the order in Supabase or Google Sheets, and delivers the file via Google Drive or R2. Each component is replaceable, but together they form a complete, sovereign commerce stack. You own the code, the data, and the process.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by choosing a stack. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) uses GitHub Pages, Google Apps Script, and NOWPayments. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) uses Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments. If you want full documentation, buy the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all blueprints and templates. Deploy the stack in 48 hours. Load your products, configure payment settings, and test end-to-end. Once live, you’ll own the entire system. No ongoing fees. No platform dependencies. Just direct sales to your customers. This isn’t a temporary fix—it’s permanent infrastructure. Use it to sell globally, accept payments in any cryptocurrency, and deliver products instantly. The system is built to scale. Start small, then expand as your business grows. Sovereignty isn’t optional—it’s the foundation.

Deploy hosting on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 4. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 5. Configure order storage in Supabase or Google Sheets. 6. Integrate file delivery via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 7. Connect NOWPayments for crypto processing. 8. Test end-to-end to ensure automatic product delivery. 9. Launch your store and start selling globally. 10. Scale as needed—the infrastructure is yours to control.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is a no-KYC payment gateway?

A no-KYC payment gateway processes transactions without requiring identity verification. It uses blockchain networks to verify payments on-chain, bypassing centralized authorities. This enables creators in regions like Kenya to accept payments without relying on platforms like Stripe or PayPal.
How does the system deliver products automatically?

The system uses webhooks from NOWPayments to verify transactions. Once payment confirms on-chain, the backend (Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script) updates the order and delivers the product via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. The process is fully automated.
Can I use this system if I’m not technical?

Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack and Edge Commerce Stack are pre-configured and deployed in 48 hours. The Complete Builder Kit includes full documentation and templates for customization. No coding required to get started.
What cryptocurrencies are supported?

NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON, with transactions under $0.10. You can price products in USD, converted to crypto at transaction time.
Do I own the infrastructure after deployment?
Yes. Once deployed, you own the entire stack. COREMERCH has no access. No platform fees. No subscriptions. Lifetime access. The infrastructure is yours to control and scale.
